_doc: Scarcity is measured in SUBSCRIPTION UNITS, never dollars (Forest 2026-09-19, 2026-09-21): % of the plan's window used versus % of the window's time elapsed, read from each vendor's own usage screen through a PTY (cortados_router/scarcity.py → ~/.cortados/scarcity.json, history in scarcity-history.jsonl). Local lanes cost nothing; their only scarce resource is free memory. This file holds the plan names and the policy knobs only; the readings are never written here.

antigravity.usage_source: agy /usage (Gemini group; a separate Claude+GPT group exists, unused)

cursor.usage_source: cursor-agent /usage (Included; Auto and named-model pools listed)

local.note: scarcity = memory pressure; 0 when the model is resident and the gate passes

policy._doc: demote_above: a lane on pace to overshoot its window goes behind its band-mates. prefer_expiring_headroom_pct: a lane within the last 15% of a ≥1-day window with at least this much headroom about to be wiped goes first. reserve_heavy_tiers_when_scarcity_above: background work is deferred and sub-agents held to the minimum. 1.0 = window spent or vendor refusing → lane skipped.

context._doc: Context policy (Hermes Agents Context session, 2026-09-24, measured over 1,285 brain calls): the harness costs ~31k prompt tokens before any history (system prompt 7-15k + persona skill + tool schemas); the ledger shows 62k average per brain call. A route must FIT the measured turn: harness + history estimate, ×1.2 headroom, ≤ the lane's transport ceiling. Fallbacks are never smaller than the primary. Local lanes only for fresh-context work (cron/report jobs, sub-agents with their own context, reflex answers on a compacted view).

ceiling_notes.codex: 272k window but the native route fails on ~400 KB request bodies: treat as 100k per call and never swap onto it mid-session
ceiling_notes.local: qwen3-8b-nothink-64k at 65,536 (the only model allowed resident on this Mac, Forest 2026-09-26); ~35k usable after the harness → fresh-context work only
ceiling_notes.antigravity: TEMPORARY CONTAINMENT 2026-10-04: automatic selection disabled (ceiling 0) until exact-session fit accounting and the 180,000 UTF-8 byte guard are activated and verified. Previous policy ceiling 40,000 tokens. AGY USER_INPUT truncates around 192,000 bytes; never clip protected exchanges or the current tool loop to fit.
ceiling_notes.codex.model_gateway: 240k only on the Donna model gateway transport (calibrated provider fit, Forest 2026-10-14): fit-calibration-2026-10-14/tokenizer S8 succeeded at 224,715 tokens and production-options L2 at 1,847,347 logical / 768,092 transport bytes; the gateway also enforces 1,800,000 / 750,000 byte caps. Hermes keeps ceiling_tokens.codex 100000.

stickiness._doc: Interactive and browser turns stay on one model (context session's item 2): a session keeps its routed model until the band rises, the requirement exceeds the model's index, or the model's pool is spent. Browser/desktop sessions are pinned harder: only a spent pool moves them.

escalation._doc: Forest 2026-09-29: difficulty is a prior from the request text; a task can turn out bigger once the code is mapped. Two signals raise it for the rest of the session (ttl_s) and for its sub-agents: the face calling router_escalate (scope larger → D_floor_larger, much_larger → D_floor_much_larger), or the turn's trajectory crossing tool_calls or files_touched (→ D_floor_trajectory). An image-only message (screenshot with no text) shows the scorer nothing but boilerplate, so it read a 20-question quiz as R0 chit-chat (2026-09-29) — such turns are floored at D_floor_attachment.
